description: Fix README and workflow-file docs inaccuracy: both claim the security audit is 'advisory by default', but the workflow's actual default expression `${{ vars.SECURITY_AUDIT_BLOCKING || 'true' }}` makes it blocking by default. The README instructs users to SET SECURITY_AUDIT_BLOCKING=true to make it blocking — which is backwards. The workflow's own line-33 comment repeats the same false claim. The end-of-line comment on line 34 correctly says 'blocking by default; set repo var to false for advisory-only' and matches the actual behavior.
steps: In README.md line 60: change 'The audit is advisory by default — set the repo variables `SECURITY_AUDIT_BLOCKING=true` and `NPM_AUDIT_SEVERITY` (default `high`) to make it gate merges.' to accurately reflect that it is BLOCKING by default: 'The audit is blocking by default — set the repo variable `SECURITY_AUDIT_BLOCKING=false` to make it advisory-only; `NPM_AUDIT_SEVERITY` (default `high`) sets the failure threshold.'

In .github/workflows/security-audit.yml line 33: fix the comment '# Both optional — defaults keep the audit non-blocking and advisory.' to '# Both optional — SECURITY_AUDIT_BLOCKING defaults to true (blocking); set to "false" for advisory-only.' This removes the internal contradiction between line 33 (says advisory) and line 34's end-of-line comment (says blocking).
No code changes needed — the workflow behavior is already correct (blocking by default). Only the two documentation strings are wrong.
acceptance_criteria: README.md no longer says 'advisory by default' or instructs users to set SECURITY_AUDIT_BLOCKING=true
README.md correctly states the audit is blocking by default and how to make it advisory
.github/workflows/security-audit.yml line 33 comment no longer contradicts the actual default on line 34
No functional code changes — only documentation strings modified
verification: grep -n 'advisory by default' README.md should return no matches
grep -n 'SECURITY_AUDIT_BLOCKING=true' README.md should return no matches (it now correctly describes SECURITY_AUDIT_BLOCKING=false)
grep -n 'blocking by default\|blocking.*default\|default.*blocking' README.md should return a match
grep -n 'non-blocking and advisory' .github/workflows/security-audit.yml should return no matches
The workflow's actual default expression (${{ vars.SECURITY_AUDIT_BLOCKING || 'true' }}) must not be changed
findings: PR #19 opened at https://github.com/randiskull/pi-kiro/pull/19. Two doc strings corrected: README.md line 60 (advisory -> blocking default) and .github/workflows/security-audit.yml line 33 comment (non-blocking -> blocking). No code changes. All verification grep checks passed.
